title: Rice left out overnight: is it safe to eat?
description: Cooked rice left out overnight should be thrown out, even if you reheat it. Here's why rice is riskier than most leftovers, and how to store it safely. Answers from USDA food safety guidance.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Rice left out overnight? Answer: Toss It. Reheating won't save it.

title: Pizza left out overnight: keep or toss?
description: Leftover pizza can sit out 2 hours at most. After a night on the counter, toss it. How long pizza lasts in the fridge and freezer, from USDA data.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Pizza left out all night? Answer: Toss It. 2 hours max on the counter.

title: How long do eggs last in the fridge?
description: Raw eggs in the shell last 3 to 5 weeks in the fridge. Keep them on a middle shelf, not in the door. Egg storage tips and how to spot a bad egg.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: How long do eggs last? Answer: 3–5 Weeks. In the fridge. Middle shelf, not the door.

title: How long does raw chicken last in the fridge?
description: Raw chicken keeps only 1 to 2 days in the fridge and up to 9 months in the freezer. Safe thawing tips and signs it has gone bad, from USDA guidance.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Raw chicken in the fridge? Answer: 1–2 Days. Then cook it or freeze it.

title: Can butter stay on the counter?
description: Butter can sit out 1 to 2 days in a covered dish, away from heat. In the fridge it lasts 1 to 2 months, frozen 6 to 9 months. Kitchen storage tips.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Butter on the counter? Answer: 1–2 Days. Fridge: 1–2 months. Keep it cool.

title: How long do avocados last in the fridge?
description: Ripen avocados on the counter, then move them to the fridge: a ripe avocado lasts 3 to 4 days. How to store cut avocado and spot a bad one.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Ripe avocado? Answer: Fridge: 3–4 Days. Ripen on the counter. Then chill.

title: How long does deli meat last after opening?
description: Opened or deli-sliced lunch meat lasts 3 to 5 days in the fridge, whatever date the pack says. Listeria tips and freezing guide, from USDA and CDC.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Opened deli meat? Answer: 3–5 Days. Opening the pack starts the clock.

title: Ground beef gray inside: is it bad?
description: A gray center in ground beef is normal: it just didn't get air. Judge by the date, smell and feel instead. Ground beef lasts 1 to 2 days in the fridge.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Gray inside your ground beef? Answer: It'S Normal. Trust the date and smell, not the color.

title: How long do hard-boiled eggs last?
description: Hard-boiled eggs last 1 week in the fridge, peeled or in the shell. Don't freeze them. Storage tips and how to tell if a boiled egg has gone bad.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Hard-boiled eggs? Answer: 1 Week. In the fridge. Peeled or not.

title: Best before vs use by: what do food dates mean?
description: Best before is about taste, use by is about safety in the UK and Europe, and sell by is for the store. A simple guide to the dates on food labels.
alt_text: Illustrated pin: Best before or use by? Answer: Taste ≠ Safety. What the dates on food really mean.
